parameters.name: TimeStamp
parameters.description: Timestamp for the latency test, indicating when the last echo in the latency test set was received or timed-out.

parameters.name: ClientMAC
parameters.description: MAC address of the station (STA) or EasyMesh Agent that the latency test ran to.

parameters.name: VID
parameters.description: The VLAN ID (VID) that the latency test ran on. A value of 0 indicates that no VLAN was specified.

parameters.name: WMMUP
parameters.description: Wireless MultiMedia (WMM) User Priority (UP) {{bibref|WMM}} that the latency test was requested to run on. A value of 8 indicates that no UP was specified.

parameters.name: DataBlockSize
parameters.description: The size of each data block, in {{units}}, that was transmitted in each echo test. The data block excludes the packet or frame header. A value of 0 indicates that no DataBlockSize was specified.

parameters.name: TestLayer
parameters.description: The OSI layer that the latency test ran on.

parameters.name: TestAlgorithm
parameters.description: The test algorithm that the latency test used.

parameters.name: SuccessCount
parameters.description: The number of successfully received echo responses. This parameter is an output of the latency test.

parameters.name: LostCount
parameters.description: The number of lost echoes in the latency test set. This parameter is an output of the latency test.

parameters.name: AverageResponseTime
parameters.description: The average round-trip time of the results of the latency test set in {{units}}. This average is across successfully received echoes only. This parameter is an output of the latency test.

parameters.name: MinimumResponseTime
parameters.description: The minimum round-trip time of the results of the latency test set in {{units}}. This minimum is across successfully received echoes only. This parameter is an output of the latency test.

parameters.name: MaximumResponseTime
parameters.description: The maximum round-trip time of the results of the latency test set in {{units}}. This maximum is across successfully received echoes only. This parameter is an output of the latency test.

object.description: Object containing the results of the most recent latency test set from the BSS to a station (STA). Each latency test set includes a number of individual echo tests. Each echo test result provides a sample of round-trip times and statistics on all the echo tests in this latency test are reported in this object.
